research_question: Does requiring one common quorum cut across every required assertion prevent cross-assertion split false PASS under correlated evidence?
repair_reason: v2 exposed parity between ARQA and a domain-majority comparator on a single boolean assertion. v3 retains v2 and adds a preregistered multi-assertion coherence benchmark rather than changing the decision threshold.
claim_boundary: bounded synthetic multi-assertion coherence and correlation benchmark; no enterprise, hardware-root, cross-host, or general-theorem claim
